description: View JSON and JSON Lines as formatted cards, a nested grid, or a node graph. Focus or expand-all mode for JSONL, synced with your editor cursor.
command.openPreviewToSide: Better JSONL: Open Preview to the Side
command.toggleExpandMode: Better JSONL: Toggle Focus / Expand All
config.defaultView.formatted: Formatted cards (Focus or Expand all for JSONL).
config.defaultView.grid: Grid of records with nested sub-grids.
config.defaultView.graph: Node graph of the current record.
config.theme: Color theme of the Better JSONL views.
config.theme.vscode: Follow the VS Code color theme.
config.theme.system: Follow the operating system (light or dark).
config.language: Language of the Better JSONL views and messages. Right-click menus and this Settings editor always use the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.wordWrap: Wrap long lines in the Formatted and Grid views. Alt+Z (Option+Z) toggles it in the open view.
config.jsonl.expandMode: How the Formatted view shows JSON Lines files.
config.jsonl.expandMode.focus: Only the current or selected lines are pretty-printed. Other lines stay on one line.
config.indent: Spaces per indent level in formatted output.
config.graph.maxNodes: The Graph view stops adding nodes after this number.
config.preview.followActiveEditor: The preview switches to the JSON or JSONL editor that becomes active.
config.syncSelection: Sync the current line between the text editor and the Better JSONL view.
config.formatDocument.enabled: Let "Format Document" rewrite JSON Lines files: each line becomes compact and canonical (records are never expanded). Off by default, so Format Document does not change JSONL files.
config.expandLines.showReminder: After "Expand Selected Lines", show a reminder that the file is not valid JSON Lines until you compact it, with a "Compact Lines" button.
